notes.title: Achievement Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I'm proud to present this new patch for achievement bug fix, spelling and grammar!

First and foremost the "Thank You For Playing <3" achievement that was hard-locked for some players has been fixed.

This update can retroactively correct the achievement error if even you have already gotten 36/37 achievements! You can get your final achievement simply by starting the game and going through the intro.
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293087/2606906c744df68afe8d4b6ffbde38b737bb5ea3.png"]Next is spelling and grammar. With the help of everyone's feedback this update includes spelling and grammar fixes errors that I missed during the game's launch. Your support and enthusiasm to make the game just that much better means so much to me! A special thanks to Choco for their extensive feedback and support.

ChuckleLove <3
